info.title: AstrBot OpenAPI v1
info.description: Target REST contract for migrating AstrBot HTTP APIs to /api/v1. Dynamic AstrBot configuration payloads are intentionally modeled as open JSON objects because their schemas are provided at runtime by template endpoints. Developer API keys currently support these scopes only: bot, provider, persona, im, config, chat, data, file, plugin, mcp, skill, plus the sensitive config:edit_admin and chat:admin sub-scopes. The config scope also grants bot and provider access, but no parent scope grants a sensitive sub-scope.

chat:admin.description: Allow `username` to use a configured AstrBot administrator ID. This sub-scope must be granted explicitly.

data.description_zh: 管理对话记录和平台会话数据。

plugin.description: Manage plugins, plugin configuration, plugin sources, and marketplace data.

mcp.description: Manage MCP server configuration and provider synchronization.

skill.description: Manage Skills, archives, files, and Shipyard Neo Skill workflows.

get.description:
Returns definitions and blank credential templates only. No configured provider or source is included. Does not contact providers.

**Required scope:** `provider`

get.summary: List unmerged model configurations without credentials
get.description:
Source inheritance is represented by provider_source_id. Source credentials are not copied into model configuration. No model list refresh is performed.

**Required scope:** `provider`

put.summary: Update a source while preserving blank credentials
put.description:
Merge explicitly supplied fields with the existing configuration. Omitted or blank credentials, including empty lists and header objects, retain existing server values. This endpoint does not clear credentials.

**Required scope:** `provider`

delete.summary: Delete a source and its linked models

**Required scope:** `provider`

patch.summary: Enable or disable a configured model

post.description:
Makes a real provider test request which may be billable. Only invoke after the user requests a test. Error text is reduced to credential-free diagnostic categories.

**Required scope:** `provider`

get.description:
Return live owned sessions with persisted pinned, starred and archived flags. Unset flags default to false. Ordered by pinned first, then session activity. Missing or foreign explicit session IDs return the same 404.

**Required scope:** `chat`

200.description: Bounded page of live owned sessions

patch.description:
Update only supplied boolean flags. At least one flag is required; nulls, coerced booleans and unknown fields are rejected. Ownership comes exclusively from authentication. No session is created by this operation.

**Required scope:** `chat`

get.summary: Search visible messages in owned sessions
get.description:
Literal substring search over complete plain-text message parts, excluding reasoning, tool data and attachment metadata. ASCII case is ignored. Results contain at most 500 text characters with optional ellipses around a match, newest message first. Deleted and foreign sessions never appear. No FTS extension is required.

**Required scope:** `chat`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Nonblank literal search string; SQL wildcard characters have no special meaning.

200.description: Bounded page of matching visible-message snippets

get.summary: List saved response versions for an owned turn
get.description:
Snapshot the current persisted turn and list its saved versions. can_select is false for older turns; branch those turns before restoring a version. Internal model context is not returned. Legacy messages without a checkpoint cannot be versioned.

**Required scope:** `chat`

post.summary: Restore a saved version of the latest owned turn
post.description:
Restore visible messages and model context together. Reject restoration while a response is running or when later turns exist. Re-read session history after success because restored assistant rows receive new IDs.

**Required scope:** `chat`

delete.summary: Delete an owned message turn and all its saved versions
delete.description:
Remove the whole checkpoint turn, including its user message and assistant/tool-linked display rows, from visible history and model context. This is not a single bubble deletion. Reject while a response is active.

**Required scope:** `chat`

post.summary: Create an owned session through a selected assistant turn
post.description:
Copy visible history and checkpoint context through the complete selected turn into a new session. Tool call/result pairs remain together. Requires a persisted assistant response with checkpoint information; this is separate from upstream side threads.

**Required scope:** `chat`

delete.summary: Delete an inactive saved version of an owned turn
delete.description:
The active version cannot be deleted through this endpoint. Select another version first, or explicitly delete the complete turn. Reject while a response is active.

**Required scope:** `chat`

API-key requests return a paginated object and require username. Dashboard requests with page or page_size return the same paginated object (sessions, page, page_size, total), scoped to the authenticated user. get.description:
List stable persona IDs and owner display names/default choices without system prompts. Global persona administration uses the existing persona-scoped endpoints.

**Required scope:** `chat`

Read preferences for the authenticated chat identity. Empty display_name uses persona_id; null model/configuration defaults follow the core.

**Required scope:** `chat`

patch.description:
Merge owner preferences without renaming persona_id. Configuration and provider defaults must be present in local chat-options. No provider request is made. Existing session choices are not changed.

**Required scope:** `chat`

get.description:
List up to 1000 live owned webchat sessions explicitly bound to this persona, ordered by session update time and stable row order descending.

**Required scope:** `chat`

Read only the authenticated owner session binding. Defaults contain no explicit persona or worldbooks and disable memory recall/tools.

**Required scope:** `chat`

patch.description:
Merge explicitly supplied context fields. Only persona_id accepts null. Reject changes while a response is active and persona changes after history exists. Worldbooks must belong to the same chat identity.

**Required scope:** `chat`

get.description:
List complete worldbooks owned by the authenticated chat identity.

**Required scope:** `chat`

post.description:
Create an owned worldbook; submitted entry IDs are discarded and fresh IDs allocated. Regex activation accepts a bounded subset, without groups, alternatives, lookarounds or backreferences.

**Required scope:** `chat`

Import version 1 worldbooks with fresh book/entry identities. Each book is saved atomically; imports create new books rather than replacing existing ones.

**Required scope:** `chat`

get.description:
Export one owned worldbook as a version 1 import-compatible object. Contains user-authored book content, but no API credentials, private logs or unrelated persona data.

**Required scope:** `chat`

put.description:
Atomically replace an owned book and its entry list. Existing entry IDs must belong to this book; omitted IDs create new entries.

**Required scope:** `chat`

delete.description:
Delete an owned book and entries, removing the book from the same owner session bindings. Previously recorded injection evidence remains a historical snapshot.

**Required scope:** `chat`

get.description:
List owned manual memories, optionally filtered by persona, substring and trash state. Invalidated memories remain visible for review but are excluded from recall.

**Required scope:** `chat`

post.description:
Create a memory for an existing persona. A source message must belong to an owned session bound to that persona. No automatic summary or embedding request is made.

**Required scope:** `chat`

patch.description:
Update owned text/type/star/trash state. Explicitly replacing text clears invalidation and detaches the old source message, treating it as a manually confirmed memory. Setting trashed=false restores a memory.

**Required scope:** `chat`

delete.description:
Move an owned memory to the trash. This is reversible through PATCH and does not permanently erase the record.

**Required scope:** `chat`

get.description:
Return up to 100 newest recorded actual injections for an owned live session, optionally selecting a checkpoint or run. Includes exact injected user-authored content. Archived checkpoint sources remain queryable; the context_sources WebSocket event carries the same item shape.

**Required scope:** `chat`
